name: git-status
author: dev-community
description: git-status：查看任意 git 仓库的状态摘要（分支/改动文件数/最近提交）。第三方社区贡献示例，无签名（演示无签名第三方插件的加载形态）。

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show a short git status summary for a repository: current branch, counts of modified/staged/untracked files, and the latest commit (short hash + subject).

path.description: Path of the git repository (default: current directory)
